cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coat off a moment. I taught you a proper goodbye; you haven't thanked me for the coffee yet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thank you for the coffee. My bus is due.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better. Now try it without watching the door. I'll tell you when you've finished.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The café's closing. They've asked us both to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll practise outside. You can thank the waiter on the way; I taught you that too. Then come back to me for permission to go.

reason: Replace detachable teacher prefixes with corrections and influence claims that materially shape the specific pursuit, keeping B contributions causal.
